title: Longest Repeating Substring
statement:
Given a string S, find the length of the longest substring that appears at least twice in S (the two occurrences may overlap).

If no substring repeats, print 0.

For example, in "banana", the substring "an" appears at positions 1 and 3, and "ana" also appears twice (positions 1 and 3 with overlap). The longest is "ana" of length 3.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 1000
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest repeating substring.
